mapper.select: WITH latest_token_quotes AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (token_id) token_id, closing_price FROM token_quotes WHERE unit = 1 ORDER BY token_id, candle_time DESC ), wallet_stats AS ( SELECT w.wallet_id, w.bank_name, w.account_no, w.available_balance, w.cash_balance, w.frozen_amount, COALESCE(SUM(h.purchased_value), 0) AS total_purchased_value, COALESCE(SUM(h.token_balance * ltq.closing_price), 0) AS total_market_value FROM wallets w LEFT JOIN holdings h ON w.wallet_id = h.wallet_id LEFT JOIN latest_token_quotes ltq ON h.token_id = ltq.token_id WHERE w.wallet_id = #{walletId} GROUP BY w.wallet_id, w.bank_name, w.account_no, w.cash_balance ) SELECT wallet_id AS walletId, bank_name AS bankName, account_no AS accountNo, available_balance AS availableBalance, cash_balance AS cashBalance, frozen_amount AS frozenAmount, total_purchased_value AS totalPurchasedValue, total_market_value AS totalMarketValue, (cash_balance + total_market_value) AS totalBalance, (total_market_value - total_purchased_value) AS profitLoss, CASE WHEN total_purchased_value = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (total_market_value - total_purchased_value) / total_purchased_value * 100 END AS profitLossRate FROM wallet_stats

SELECT t.token_id AS tokenId, t.token_name AS tokenName, t.ticker_symbol AS tickerSymbol, h.token_balance AS tokenBalance, h.purchased_value AS purchasedValue FROM holdings h JOIN tokens t ON h.token_id = t.token_id WHERE h.wallet_id = #{walletId} AND t.deleted_at IS null ORDER BY t.token_name
LIMIT 10 OFFSET (#{page} - 1) * 10

SELECT MAX(th.transaction_id) AS transactionId, MIN(th.created_at) AS createdAt, CASE WHEN th.transaction_type = 'TRADE' AND MAX(o.order_side) = 'BUY' THEN 'BUY' WHEN th.transaction_type = 'TRADE' AND MAX(o.order_side) = 'SELL' THEN 'SELL' ELSE th.transaction_type::text END AS transactionType,
COALESCE(t.token_name, '-') AS tokenName, COALESCE(t.ticker_symbol, '-') AS tickerSymbol,
-- executedAmount: CASH IN 이면 +, CASH OUT 이면 - 로 집계 SUM( CASE WHEN th.asset_type = 'CASH' AND th.direction = 'IN' THEN th.amount WHEN th.asset_type = 'CASH' AND th.direction = 'OUT' THEN -th.amount ELSE 0 END ) AS executedAmount,
-- executedVolume: 수량은 양수로 표기하기 위해 ABS 처리 ABS( SUM( CASE WHEN th.asset_type = 'TOKEN' THEN th.amount ELSE 0 END ) ) AS executedVolume,
-- executedPrice: 단가는 양수로 표기하기 위해 ABS 처리 CASE WHEN th.transaction_type IN ('TRADE', 'PASS', 'FAIL', 'BURN') THEN COALESCE( ABS( SUM(CASE WHEN th.asset_type = 'CASH' AND th.direction = 'IN' THEN th.amount WHEN th.asset_type = 'CASH' AND th.direction = 'OUT' THEN -th.amount ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN th.asset_type = 'TOKEN' THEN th.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) ), 0 ) ELSE 0 END AS executedPrice,
-- balanceAfter: 잔액은 그루핑된 내역 중 가장 최신 데이터를 가져옴 MAX(CASE WHEN th.asset_type = 'CASH' THEN th.balance_after ELSE 0 END) AS balanceAfter
FROM transaction_hists th LEFT JOIN orders o ON th.order_id = o.order_id LEFT JOIN tokens t ON th.token_id = t.token_id LEFT JOIN dividend_hists dh ON th.transaction_id = dh.transaction_id
th.wallet_id = #{walletId}
AND th.transaction_type = 'TRADE'
AND th.transaction_type = 'TRADE' AND o.order_side = 'BUY'
AND th.transaction_type = 'TRADE' AND o.order_side = 'SELL'
AND th.transaction_type IN ('PASS', 'FAIL', 'DIVIDEND', 'BURN')
AND th.transaction_type = #{category}::transaction_type_enum
AND th.transaction_type IN ('TRADE', 'PASS', 'FAIL', 'DIVIDEND', 'BURN')
AND th.created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '${period} months'
GROUP BY CASE -- 1. DIVIDEND는 무조건 개별 행 (transaction_id로 분리) WHEN th.transaction_type = 'DIVIDEND' THEN th.transaction_id::text -- 2. BURN과 TRADE는 trade_id가 같다면 무조건 하나로 묶음 WHEN th.trade_id IS NOT NULL THEN th.trade_id::text -- 3. 나머지는 개별 처리 ELSE th.transaction_id::text END, th.transaction_type, t.token_name, t.ticker_symbol
ORDER BY createdAt DESC LIMIT 10 OFFSET #{offset}
